statement.p: Remember that e is a real number (a constant). You may see it most often as part of an exponential function such as f(x)=e^x\text{,} but e itself is just a number. Which of the following statements about the number e are true, and which are false? Try to answer all of them without using a calculator.

li.p:
e^a is positive for all real numbers a
?
True
False
